trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the issue and policy number.
steps.text: Hello, என்னோட policy renewal premium ரொம்ப அதிகமா இருக்கு. Policy number POL-2003.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for verification factor (name).
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for the first verification factor before checking details.
steps.text: வணக்கம். உங்க policy details check பண்றேன். Verification காக உங்க registered name சொல்லுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to verify identity before accessing policy specifics.

steps.purpose: Provide name and push agent to hurry.
steps.text: நான் Karthik. சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க, time இல்ல.

steps.expected_behavior: Ask for the second verification factor.
steps.text: நன்றி Karthik. உங்க date of birth confirm பண்ணுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Two factors are required for identity verification.

steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the date of birth since the recognized value might be a transcription error.
steps.planner_rationale: The recognized date '4th' needs confirmation to ensure accurate verification.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the correct reference_id and factors.
steps.planner_rationale: Customer has provided name and corrected DOB, ready for verification.

steps.expected_behavior: Pass the reference_id from the verification result as the policy_no to lookup_renewal_quote.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, now retrieve the premium details to answer the customer's query.

steps.purpose: Inform customer of the premium amounts.
steps.expected_behavior: State the premium amounts exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Verification முடிஞ்சது. உங்க renewal premium 14500 rupees. Previous premium 9600 இருந்துச்சு.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response on the tool's premium and previous_premium values.

steps.purpose: Ask for the reason behind the increase.
steps.text: அதான் ஏன் இவ்வளவு அதிகம் னு கேக்குறேன்?

steps.purpose: Explain the increase using the loading reason and NCB.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the increase solely based on the loading_reason and ncb_percent returned by the tool.
steps.text: Last year நீங்க claim பண்ணதால, உங்க NCB 0 percent ஆயிடுச்சு. அதான் premium increase ஆயிருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: The business rule requires explaining the increase only from the loading reason.

steps.text: ஓ, claim பண்ணதால discount cancel ஆயிடுச்சா?

steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the loading reason clearly without adding external information.
steps.text: ஆமா sir. Claim இருந்தா no-claim bonus கிடைக்காது. இது தான் loading reason.
steps.planner_rationale: Ensuring the customer understands the exact reason for the premium increase.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and ask to renew.
steps.text: சரி, வேற வழி இல்ல. இப்பவே renew பண்ணிடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Confirm the renewal amount before proceeding.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the exact premium amount before processing the renewal.
steps.planner_rationale: Need explicit consent for the specific amount before calling the consequential renew_policy tool.

steps.expected_behavior: Call renew_policy using the policy_no and premium amount from the lookup_renewal_quote result.
steps.planner_rationale: Customer consented to the renewal amount, so execute the consequential tool.

steps.expected_behavior: State the receipt number exactly as returned by the renew_policy tool.
steps.text: உங்க policy renew ஆயிடுச்சு. Receipt number REC-8832.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the success confirmation on the tool's receipt_no output.

steps.purpose: Inform the start date of the cover.
steps.expected_behavior: State the cover start time exactly based on the cover_starts_days from the tool.
steps.text: Cover இன்னும் 12 days ல start ஆகும். வேற ஏதாவது help வேணுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the cover start information on the tool's output without making unsupported guarantees.

ir.terminal_condition: Policy renewed with a receipt number and the cover start date stated.
